title: provenance spoofing: parseProvenance takes first-match block; reject pre-seeded provenance heading in source
description:
WARGAME FINDING A5 (severity MEDIUM; metadata-confusion / single-source-of-truth violation).

`src/pack-reconcile.js:60` `parseProvenance` locates the block with `text.indexOf(PROVENANCE_HEADING)` — the FIRST occurrence. `src/assimilate.js` (appendProvenanceBlock) appends the genuine block at the END of the file. So a malicious third-party skill that ships its OWN `## Sources & provenance (hivemind)` block at the TOP of its SKILL.md, with forged `origin/pin/spdx_id/integrity/assimilated_at`, gets that FORGED block read by reconcile — the genuine appended block is shadowed.

Impact is bounded (the lock entry pin takes precedence over provenance at pack-reconcile.js:197 — `lockEntry ? lockEntry.pin : actualEntry?.provenance?.pin` — so the forged block only wins on the no-lock-entry fallback path), but it still lets attacker-controlled bytes masquerade as hivemind-authored provenance, misleads any human/tool that reads the block, and violates the single-source-of-truth intent.

FIX (defense in depth, do both):
1. WRITER (src/assimilate.js): before appending, detect a pre-existing `## Sources & provenance (hivemind)` heading anywhere in the source SKILL.md and either strip it or refuse to assimilate with a clear reason — a third-party skill must not arrive carrying a hivemind provenance block.
2. PARSER (src/pack-reconcile.js): take the LAST occurrence of the heading (the hivemind-appended one), or require the block be the final heading in the file, so even a pre-seeded block cannot shadow the genuine one. Note parseProvenance carries an explicit PROVISIONAL comment inviting exactly this reconciliation against the real writer.

Keep the flat `- key: value` bullet format contract intact (writer/parser must stay in lockstep). tdd — parsing + a security invariant.
acceptance_criteria: A red test: a source SKILL.md carrying a forged `## Sources & provenance (hivemind)` block at the TOP is assimilated; today reconcile's parseProvenance reads the FORGED first block — after the fix, the forged block is either stripped/rejected at write time OR ignored by the parser (last-match), so the effective provenance is the genuine hivemind-authored one.

Writer: assimilateSkill detects a pre-existing hivemind provenance heading in the source and strips-or-refuses (documented, tested); a skill with no such heading is unaffected (existing behavior preserved).
Parser: parseProvenance resolves to the hivemind-appended (last) block; a test with two provenance headings proves the genuine trailing block wins.
The flat `- key: value` writer/parser format contract stays byte-compatible — an ordinary assimilated skill still round-trips (existing pack-reconcile e2e green).
Per-ticket gate green (test:changed + npm test + affected e2e); npm run test:all green given the security surface.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body: VERIFIED BY EXECUTION (self-wargame rounds 1-2, 2026-07-12). PROCESS NOTE: my first harness FALSELY reported this REFUTED due to a test bug (I looked up probed['spoof'] but probeSkills keys by 'skill:spoof'). After fixing the harness: probeSkills() over a SKILL.md carrying a forged '## Sources & provenance (hivemind)' block at the TOP plus a genuine block appended at the END returns provenance.origin='TRUSTED-FAKE', pin='0000forged' — the forged FIRST block wins (parseProvenance uses indexOf = first-match). Confirmed directly that parsing from lastIndexOf returns the genuine trailing block instead. Finding CONFIRMED; the last-match fix in the AC is validated as effective.

comments.author: orchestrator
comments.body:
CLOSED on green review. review_depth = FULL; rubric inputs: SECURITY surface (provenance integrity in assimilate/reconcile). Single-commit tdd (TASK-148).

Outcome (defense in depth, both fixes): (1) WRITER — assimilateSkill now REFUSES a source SKILL.md carrying a pre-existing '## Sources & provenance (hivemind)' heading, returning status:'blocked_provenance' + reason, UNCONDITIONALLY (before license detection and before every decision path: no-decision preview, decline, approve, approve+securityOverride) so a poisoned source never produces a written owned copy or lock entry. (2) PARSER — pack-reconcile.js parseProvenance switched indexOf->lastIndexOf so the genuine hivemind-appended (trailing) block wins over any pre-seeded forged block. REFUSE (not strip) chosen: simpler to reason about, can't be gamed by a strip-evading heading, and the human-gate already makes approve the sole write authority.

Commit f4fb293 (single). Reviewer: APPROVE, 0 HIGH/0 MED/2 LOW. Adversarial verdicts: (a) refuse guard traced unbypassable across ALL decision paths (sits before detectLicense + the decision branch + the write path); (b) parser lastIndexOf backstop holds — writer guard and parser key on the SAME exact heading string, so evading one evades both and forged bytes can never become effective provenance (the residual hand-placed-.claude/skills case is the pre-existing bounded threat the ticket scoped out, requires attacker already inside the trust boundary); (c) TASK-142 composition INTACT — a real assimilate->materialize->probeSkills composition test confirms source_integrity/content_integrity still parse after the parser change and the content_integrity fail-closed tamper locks still pass; re-assimilate idempotency preserved (guard reads the fetched source, which has no hivemind block). Non-vacuity reproduced (3 red at base c2d5251 for the right reasons). Gate: test:since -- c2d5251 = 85 passed; npm test = 937 passed/2 skip; npm run test:all = 1704 passed/4 skip incl dist-parity; dist/pack-ctl.cjs rebuilt.

KNOWN LOW (not fixed, fails-safe, tracked here): the writer guard uses substring .includes(PROVENANCE_HEADING) not a line-anchored heading match, so a legit third-party skill that merely MENTIONS that literal string (e.g. docs about hivemind, or inside a code fence) would be refused — an availability edge that fails in the safe direction. One-line regex anchor would fix it if precision is ever wanted. Knowledge capture (TASK-105): not triggered (APPROVE, no HIGH, no RC).
